question: Why does the single power of emission unfold as agitation?
premises: The power of emission is one.
Its unfolding as agitation occurs because effort is doubled.
inference: Agitated emission is not a second power but the one emissive power intensified by doubled effort.
uncertainties: The precise technical meaning of prayatna-dviguṇatva is not fully specified.
plain_english: Therefore this single power of emission unfolds. Emission itself becomes agitated because of the doubling of effort.
